Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

A body of mass 2 kg is kept by pressing to a vertical wall by a force of 100 N. The friction between wall and body is 0.3. Then the frictional force is equal to

result.working: Normal force N = 100 N, so the limiting friction is μN = 0.3 × 100 = 30 N. The weight is mg = 2 × 10 = 20 N (taking g = 10 m/s²). Since 20 N < 30 N, the body stays at rest and static friction balances the weight. Frictional force = 20 N.
result.note: Taking g = 9.8 m/s² gives 19.6 N, which rounds to 20 N. The friction is static, not μN = 30 N.
